description: This file contains test cases for the WakeWordGate feature in the SwabbleKit project, specifically testing wake word detection and command extraction logic.

classes.name: WakeWordGateTests
classes.description: A test suite for WakeWordGate functionalities, including trigger matching and command extraction.
